question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 50% above its cost price and offers a 30% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹91, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100 units.

List Price (MP) = 100 + 50% = 150 units.

Selling Price (SP) = 150 − 30% of 150 = 105 units.

Profit = SP − CP = 105 − 100 = 5 units.

5 units = ₹91 ⇒ List Price (150 units) = (91 ÷ 5) × 150 = ₹2730.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2730.**
